errors.text_span: rises to roughly 98.5% at N=5, remains steady at N=10
errors.evidence: The blue line rises to approximately 98% at N=5 and continues to rise to its peak of approximately 98.5% at N=10. The description incorrectly states the peak value occurs at N=5 and that the line is steady between N=5 and N=10.
The line with open square markers is orange, not red.
The peak of the orange line (described as "red") at N=10 is approximately 98%, not 98.5%. It is visibly lower than the peak of the blue line, which is at approximately 98.5%.
The line with open diamond markers is yellow/gold, not orange. The machine description has already used 'red' to misidentify the orange line, making this color assignment doubly confusing.
